open_mysteries: What caused the glass pavement in Chicago to bleed magical resonance into Leo's apartment?
Who are the Siphon Weavers and why are they actively tracking and destroying dimensional rifts?
Why is the auxiliary portal bifurcated between rainy Chicago and Vaelen?
How long has the Dredge Cartel been secretly hoarding Earth artifacts in stasis?
important_events: Kaelen used her induction gauntlet to bypass the pneumatic blast door of the Cartel Archive Annex.
The party discovered the Cartel's secret stash of Earth relics suspended in stasis pods, including a Chicago subway gate.
Kaelen immobilized Cartel Archivist Selas before he could trigger the vault's blast doors.
Orin engaged the auxiliary portal using his brass astrolabe, sparking an unstable bifurcated gate.
A Siphon Weaver drone detected the portal ignition and shattered the vault's glass dome to attack.
continuity_rules: Keep recurring character identities and visual traits consistent.
Invent new characters, places and plotlines when narratively useful.
Maintain cause and effect across episodes.
The Chicago anchor is destroyed; auxiliary crossings are unstable and risk interdimensional overlap.
recent_episode_summaries: Episode 5: Leo, Mira, Orin, and Kaelen board a rusted transit car to cross a subterranean chasm in Vaelen, surviving a silt-shark attack and crash-landing at the Silt Docks.

Episode 6: Leo, Mira, Orin, and Kaelen evade Dredge Cartel enforcer Varn at the Silt Docks using a crane distraction and Kaelen's magnetic grapple, escaping to the upper catwalks where Orin's astrolabe detects an auxiliary portal frequency.

Episode 7: Infiltrating the Cartel Archive Vault, Leo and the group discover hoarded Earth relics. Kaelen restrains Archivist Selas while Orin ignites the auxiliary portal ring, only for an unstable bifurcated rift to open just as a Siphon Weaver drone smashes through the ceiling dome.

Episode 7: Pursuing the harmonic frequency detected from the Silt Docks catwalks, Leo and his companions breach the Cartel's fortified archive annex and discover decades of salvaged Earth relics preserved in stasis pods. After neutralizing Archivist Selas, Orin uses his astrolabe to ignite an auxiliary portal, but the gate destabilizes into a bifurcated spatial tear between Chicago and Vaelen just as a predatory Siphon Weaver drone shatters the ceiling dome overhead, forcing an immediate blind leap into the unknown.
